packs.title: Flowstate Grooves
notes: Drums only: the grooves are rhythm patterns. Chords, bass and melodies come from the planner and the other packs.

packs.title: Flowstate MIDI Starter
notes: No drums: the pack has no GodFlow drum MIDI, and Flowstate does not make fake drum entries.
No melodies: v1's five pop 'melody' files are chord stacks on every onset, so they are pop chords here (owner's call, 2026-10-01).
Left out bass-01: Notes from C2 to B4 leave the bass range C1-C4; the line is also 32 bars with 16 empty ones.
Left out bass-03: A C#4 in the last-bar fill leaves the bass range C1-C4.
Left out bass-04: A dancehall line between G3 and F4, above the bass range C1-C4.
